description: The look this workspace's videos follow, as learned from its style references: pacing, hook, on-screen text, transitions, caption tone, aspect and length. Read it before drafting a caption or editing a video, and follow it. Version 0 means none yet: study the references and save one with style_profile_set. new_reference_ids lists references added since this version was learned.

version.description: An older version from history; the newest when left out.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: style_profile_get
title: Get the style profile
